prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent pixel-art sprite sheet for a chibi catgirl game's knockout ANIMATION BLOCKING, not a poster.

REFERENCE ROLES: image 1 is the character identity and exact swimwear reference. Image 2 is the existing in-game pixel style and face proportions. Image 3 is ONLY a motion reference: the grey seal has been knocked off balance and is flopping sideways out of the float; do not copy seals, the background, UI, effects, or typography.

Generate ONE sheet with FOUR isolated complete Juzi catgirl figures in a clean 2-column by 2-row grid, read top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. Transparent background with real alpha, no checkerboard drawn, no ground, no rings, no water, no labels. Large clear transparent gutters at the sheet's midlines and a margin around every silhouette. Same character size and head diameter in all cells, full anatomy in each cell including both bare feet and the head-top kitten. Coarse, crisp square pixel clusters, dark warm-brown stepped outlines, limited orange/cream palette, no smooth vector curves or painted blur.

IDENTITY LOCK: Juzi has a very large orange bobbed head, orange tabby cat ears, orange stripe markings, amber eyes (may squeeze shut in pain), white flower with yellow centre and green leaves at HER LEFT temple, striped orange tail, and a small orange tabby kitten gripping her hair. One miniature kitten per figure and it stays gripping the head through EVERY pose, leaning together with her, never flying separately. Exact reference orange-and-cream ONE-PIECE SWIMSUIT, sailor collar and small frilled shoulder/hip trim, orange flower medallion on chest. BARE FEET, no shoes, no socks, no shorts or skirt, no new costume. Childlike chibi proportions, entirely nonsexual cartoon game character.

The action is INVOLUNTARILY HIT AND TUMBLED, not voluntarily jumping, not an ejection seat. The character has no ground to push off. Never a symmetrical hands-up cheering pose, never the old upright seated doll position. This is a hit from screen-left pushing her pelvis/chest toward screen-right: the head and loose limbs LAG. Head, chest, hips, hands and feet do NOT move as a rigid sticker. Clear asymmetric C-shaped body line with overlapping/dragging parts. Her body should look limp and surprised rather than deliberately exercising or posing.

POSE 1 TOP LEFT: the hit reaction just before dislodging. Upper body is abruptly knocked off balance sideways; torso tilts about 25 degrees to the right, heavy head lags a little to the left, one shoulder lower than the other. Eyes squeeze shut, startled small O mouth. One forearm folded defensively toward chest, the other arm hanging/flung sideways, both legs bent and dangling below (will be masked by water at runtime). No crouch or jump preparation.
POSE 2 TOP RIGHT: she has just been yanked out of the float by the impact. Pelvis/torso lead toward upper-right, head lags to upper-left, tiny bare feet trail lower-left, a strong curved off-balance silhouette, body tilted about 45 degrees. Arms sweep back unevenly, no raising hands above her head. Three-quarter face rather than straight front; flower and kitten remain identifiable.
POSE 3 BOTTOM LEFT: involuntary sideways tumble, about 65 degrees rightward tilt. Heavy head rolls with shoulder, hips fold in an uncontrolled C shape, one knee loosely bent and the other foot trailing. Two arms at different angles, not a deliberate knees-to-chest jump. Kitten still flattened against and gripping head.
POSE 4 BOTTOM RIGHT: continuation/follow-through of that SAME tumble, about 80 degrees rightward tilt, not a new action. Head/chest have turned first; forearms, dangling feet and tail are catching up a little later. Asymmetric loose limbs and distressed expression, no aerobatic flying pose, no reaching forward like a superhero.

All four are the SAME sequential motion and SAME face/costume/proportions. Keep the strongest pixel style of image 2. The purpose is to judge motion readability at small game sprite size. Do not add motion lines, stars, splashes or glow which could hide an unclear pose.
